summary: October is a content management system built on top of the Laravel PHP framework. It provides a structured environment for building websites and web applications using standard PHP development patterns.
goodFor: Developers who already use Laravel and want a content management layer structured around its ecosystem.
watchOut: The software uses a proprietary licence, which may impose restrictions on commercial use or redistribution depending on the specific terms set by the authors.
deployNotes: You will typically need a standard LEMP or LAMP stack with a relational database like MySQL or PostgreSQL, alongside persistent storage for user-uploaded assets.
